task:
Colony Planner facility picker: ports are hidden on later pages. Fix the grouping and paging in apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/FacilityPicker.svelte.

Owner report (production, 2026-11-01): on a landable body the picker shows only Coriolis and Dodecahedron; Ocellus and Orbis appear missing. Cause: `matches` keeps catalogue order (which interleaves orbital ports, surface settlements, orbital installations and outposts), then `visible = matches.slice(page*6, page*6+6)` pages across every kind. On a landable non-ringed body page 1 is Coriolis, Dodecahedron, Extraction, High Tech, Industrial, Military; Ocellus and Orbis are on page 2; the T1 orbital outposts are on pages 4-5; Port and the surface outposts are on pages 5-6. The page buttons sit below the Surface list and are easy to miss.

Required behaviour:
1. Group the picker into ordered sections and never split a section across pages: Orbital ports, Orbital installations, Surface ports, Surface settlements and hubs (use the existing is_port flag and allowed_location; ringed_orbital counts as orbital and keeps its has_rings gate via facilityFitsLocation). Within each section sort by tier descending then name, so T3 ports (Dodecahedron, Ocellus, Orbis) come first, then Coriolis and Asteroid Base, then T1 outposts.
2. When the plan has no sites yet (Primary Port step), list only port sections first and keep non-port facilities visibly listed but disabled as today, below the ports.
3. Remove the 6-per-page slicing from what is LISTED. Keep the server CP-preview requests bounded: only request previews for at most 6 facilities at a time, for example the ones currently scrolled into view (IntersectionObserver) or the first 6 of an expanded section, with a "Show costs" fallback. Do not add catalogue constants as cost stand-ins (keep the existing comment's rule). Keep the existing debounce and AbortController behaviour.
4. Search still filters across all sections; an empty section is hidden; "No matching facilities." stays.
5. Accessibility: each section is a heading plus list; buttons keep data-facility-id; keyboard order follows visual order.

Tests: update apps/web/src/lib/features/plan tests (FacilityPicker coverage is in PlanWorkspace.test.ts and related files) to assert that on a landable body with no sites all of Dodecahedron, Ocellus, Orbis, Coriolis appear in the first section without paging, that Asteroid Base appears only with has_rings, and that no more than 6 preview requests are in flight at once. Update any Cypress planner spec selectors that relied on picker paging. Add a CHANGES.md entry. Run pnpm check, pnpm test and pnpm build in apps/web.
